citations.claim: first energy violation: total energy drifted to -125.75 from -82.62 initial during deep close encounter
body 0 accelerated to high speed during close approach, showing stiff encounter integrator failed to resolve
one step earlier energy already drifting (-86.62) as separation shrank to 0.52 with only 19 substeps

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.03311669242036018 to 0.005 keeping all bodies, G, seed and steps=9 identical; finer outer step lets substepped leapfrog resolve the deep close encounter (distance 0.15 < softening 0.3) and energy stays conserved

explanation: Two heavy bodies undergo a deep close encounter: separation falls from 0.92 (step7) to 0.52 (step8) to 0.15 (step9), i.e. below softening 0.3, while speeds rise to ~12. With large outer dt~0.033 the substep controller (16->19->25 substeps) increases but insufficiently, so leapfrog integration error accumulates and total energy drops from -82.6 to -125.75, exceeding the 2% tolerance. Reducing only dt removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
vision_note: Two small blue bodies on the left approach each other across steps 6 to 7 and nearly touch in step 8. By step 9 they overlap into a single merged blob with only faint trails behind.
